blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police arrested Tuesday the primary suspect in the murder of a couple in Banisilan, North Cotabato province, and recovered a large amount of cash and some of the victims’ jewelry, police said. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, regional director of the Police Regional Office 12 (PRO-12), said the suspect, alias “Meroy,” 53, a distant relative of the victims, was arrested at about 10:30 a.m. Tuesday in Sitio Kib-al, Barangay Guiling, Alamada, North Cotabato.
